name: web_search
description: Search the web for up-to-date information, documentation, news, and factual verification. Omit max_results to use PELDRUN Search Settings.
short_description: Real-time web search via configurable provider.
store_description: Built-in search tool that queries the configured PELDRUN search provider to retrieve up-to-date information, documentation, news, and factual references. Supports provider-level search settings and per-call result limits.

ar.short_description: Real-time web search via configurable provider.

examples.output_preview: Top 3 results with titles, snippets, and URLs.

usage_notes: Prefer passing only `query`. Omit `max_results` to inherit PELDRUN Search Settings; the configured provider ceiling is always enforced.

query.description: Search query string to look up on the web.

max_results.description: Optional desired maximum number of results. Omit this argument to use PELDRUN Search Settings. The configured provider ceiling and provider capability maximum are always enforced.
